steps.title: Welcome to the till
steps.text: Sell to cash customers and on employee accounts. Everything is in reach of one hand on a touch screen.

steps.title: Start the day
steps.text: Start the day with your opening cash before selling. The chip at the top shows the day that's open.

steps.title: Find or scan
steps.text: Scan a barcode, or type to search for an item.

steps.title: Item buttons
steps.text: Tap an item to add it. Categories take you through the buttons.

steps.title: The basket
steps.text: What's being bought. Tap a line to change the quantity or remove it.

steps.title: Pay
steps.text: Cash, card, or on the employee's account (with their fingerprint, face or PIN if your company uses that). The slip prints.

steps.title: Returns
steps.text: Cash returns by scanning the item; employee returns are found on their own sale and credited to their account.

steps.title: My Sales
steps.text: Your sales today; reprint a slip.

steps.title: Cash Out
steps.text: Take cash out of the drawer (for example to the safe), with a reason.

steps.title: Stock Take
steps.text: Count the stock on the shelf.

steps.title: Cash-Up
steps.text: End the day: count the cash; differences are recorded for the manager.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: Tap ? for this tour any time.
